title.en: Short: Cheapest item or cheapest total?

en.title: Cheapest item or cheapest total?
lines: The cheapest soap isn't always the cheapest shop.
In this made-up example, Shop A charges £3.90 for detergent and £3.50 for soap.
Shop B charges £4.10 and £3.00, so £7.10 in total.
Shop B isn't cheapest on everything, but it wins on the total.
An AI agent could add this up for you. Do you check the total, or each price? Tell me below.
